title: Define portable animation clip and deterministic sampling contract
description:
## Summary
Define a runtime-portable animation clip and deterministic sampling contract for indexed creature poses.

## User Mandate
> Please take everything from this good branch and take over for this agent:

STRICT. Preserve the uncaptured clip and sampling finding from the reviewed follow-up branch without importing its raw task JSON or duplicate records.

## Scope
- Define clip channels against authoritative indexed skeleton identity.
- Specify deterministic time sampling, looping, endpoint behavior, missing-channel behavior, and malformed-data rejection.
- Keep Unity Animator/Avatar integration, locomotion, blending policy, and editor authoring out of scope.
- Coordinate with TSK-0190 and TSK-0191 without duplicating their pose contract or buffer ownership.

## Acceptance Criteria
- The contract is portable runtime data with stable indexed identity and deterministic sampling results.
- Tests cover exact endpoints, looping, non-looping clamp, malformed channel lengths, incompatible skeletons, and non-finite values.
- Sampling can feed the reusable indexed pose buffer without per-sample semantic ID resolution.
- No raw branch task JSON or duplicate TSK key is imported.

## Validation
Run whole-project .NET compilation, focused runtime tests, and Unity PlayMode validation for the concrete sampling path. Record exact results and Unity availability.

## Findings
The reviewed follow-up branch identified a portable animation clip plus deterministic sampling contract that is not captured by the existing full-pose contract or reusable-buffer tasks.

## Blockers
No implementation or Unity execution has been performed for this finding.

## Next Step
Design the portable clip/channel schema and deterministic sampling tests with TSK-0190 and TSK-0191 as dependencies.

## Reconciliation
Renumbered from TSK-0198 on 2026-09-12. TSK-0198 now resolves uniquely to the in-progress stream-preview performance task tsk-0198-stream-preview-generation-hotpaths-and-direct-edge-ownership; this record keeps the animation clip and sampling contract.

comments.body: Task created from reviewed follow-up finding. Task-record integrity validation is currently blocked by pre-existing normalized-key collisions in TSK-0153, TSK-0188, and TSK-0189; Scripts/Normalize-TaskRecords.ps1 reported all three and modified no files. This task remains Backlog.

comments.author: anonymous
comments.body:
Sampler scratch fix validated end-to-end (2026-09-11). `DensityGrid.SamplePortable` now bounds the scheduled work-item set to `ScratchValueBudget` and processes rows in windows; `SdfSamplingRowBatchJob` takes `RowStart`. This removes the silent out-of-bounds scratch writes that the pushed work-item offset introduced.

Evidence:
- EditMode 148/148 passed. PlayMode full 751 total / 709 passed / 42 failed (`TestResults.xml`, complete list recovered by recursive parse past the runner's 25-cap).
- The determinism cluster recorded in `TSK-0194` now passes: `FastFieldSamplingTests.FastCulling_IsDeterministic`, `GenerationIntegrityTests.SampleAndExtract_RepeatedRuns_AreBitIdentical`, `CanonicalMorphologyChainTests` x3, `GeneratedCreatureTests` x3, `CreatureGenerationSchedulerTests.AsyncGeneration_MatchesSynchronousMeshAndColors`. 12 recorded failures resolved in total.
- Editor: 4 regenerations on unchanged DNA/settings gave 20962 triangles / 10483 vertices every time; TotalGeneration 1314.8 ms (cold), 789.0, 779.9, 707.4 ms — inside the documented 701.9–798.8 ms baseline. No detached islands.
- Screenshot: `Assets/Screenshots/cc-sdf-race-fix-scene-2026-09-11.png`.

Remaining 42 PlayMode failures are pre-existing non-sampler clusters (skeleton/bone, marching-cubes winding, influence domains, non-finite validation, FABRIK/IK). See `TSK-0212` for the acceptance-criteria disposition and `TSK-0194` for the full delta.
